findings.documented_observation: Library metadata and files are shared; membership, enable state, options and load order belong to a profile.
findings.proposed_application: Use normalized content/version records and separate profile state, not duplicate files for every tab.
findings.acceptance: Rename a shared item in two profiles; independently change options; removing one profile preserves files and the other profile.

findings.documented_observation: Selecting a profile does not install it; the game reflects the last successful deployment.
findings.proposed_application: Expose selected profile, deployed profile and dirty changes separately. Persist an operation journal and snapshot digest before file writes.
findings.acceptance: Switch profiles without deploy; UI must not claim the selected profile is active in-game. Interrupted deployment becomes unknown/partial, never green.

findings.documented_observation: Documentation warns that cancelling during copy can leave game files inconsistent; removal of a deployed mod triggers a purge.
findings.proposed_application: Improve with scoped ownership manifests, staged writes, recoverable backups and a preview of removal effects. Do not adopt broad destructive purge blindly.
findings.acceptance: Inject failure at every copy/rename boundary; preserve unmanaged files; restart must offer resume or rollback with honest status.

findings.documented_observation: Thumbnail rings distinguish deployed, changed and not deployed; images can be previewed.
findings.proposed_application: Carry visual deployment state into existing health/media pillars, with text and accessible icons, not color alone. Unknown and failed are additional states.
findings.acceptance: Keyboard and screen-reader inspection identifies every state; stale external edits cannot retain a verified indicator.

findings.documented_observation: Per-view separators have colors, section tint, exportable styles and a scroll minimap. Search and tag filters coexist.
findings.proposed_application: Use stable IDs and scroll anchors in virtualized lists; provide saved views, tabs, separators and section navigation on deep black surfaces.
findings.acceptance: At 100k synthetic records preserve selected IDs and scroll anchor after filter, toggle, update and separator move; measure p95 frame/search latency.

findings.documented_observation: Selection supports batch operations; rapid toggles are batched, and mixed enabled selection follows a majority rule.
findings.proposed_application: Keep batching, but prefer explicit Enable selected / Disable selected instead of surprising majority toggles. Snapshot selected IDs before asynchronous work.
findings.acceptance: Change search during batch action; only original chosen IDs change. Repeated clicks do not duplicate jobs.

findings.documented_observation: Conflict details identify overlapping patches, their order and option/sub-option location; overlap is advisory rather than proof of incompatibility.
findings.proposed_application: Separate path overlap from semantic record conflict, dependency failure and community crash evidence. Preserve user override for advisories.
findings.acceptance: Two intentional overrides remain runnable; disabled option files do not create active conflicts; every alert exposes its evidence and winning record/file.

findings.documented_observation: Download queue distinguishes pending, running, complete and failed; completed update controls become install actions.
findings.proposed_application: Keep fetched, verified, staged, installed and deployed states separate. Preserve provenance and resumability; do not equate successful transfer with successful installation.
findings.acceptance: Simulate auth expiry, duplicate NXM input, corrupt archive, restart and update conflict; no false installed badge or lost retry details.

findings.documented_observation: Lobby loads retain ordering and option choices, but share only mods with Nexus identifiers.
findings.proposed_application: Adopt provider-neutral, content-version-pinned loadout manifests with source capability adapters, without redistributing restricted payloads.
findings.acceptance: A mixed-source loadout resolves exact versions or reports unavailable; local modifications and missing rights remain visible instead of silently substituted.

findings.documented_observation: Current builder separates folder structure from option definitions and keeps editor state apart from built manifests.
findings.proposed_application: Separate reusable recipe/asset graphs, presentation state and executable package manifests in Athena Foundry.
findings.acceptance: Export/import preserves editor layout and option mapping while clean distributable output excludes editor-only metadata.

findings.documented_observation: Manifest V1 identifies packs by GUID and uses relative include paths. Description is required but may be empty.
findings.proposed_application: Implement a separately tested compatibility adapter after obtaining package fixtures; validate archive traversal, case collisions and missing includes in addition to documented fields.
findings.acceptance: Owned fixture round-trip preserves GUID, empty descriptions, included paths and options; malicious absolute, parent traversal or symlink escapes are rejected.

findings.documented_observation: Project export can preserve work that would fail build validation; hard errors and optional warnings are different.
findings.proposed_application: Save imperfect drafts without losing ideas; validate before execution/export and make warnings actionable. Keep schema migration reversible.
findings.acceptance: Save an incomplete draft, restart, correct it and build; migration failure leaves original intact; warning override does not bypass structural errors.

findings.documented_observation: Options map folders independently; folder renaming updates include paths and deletion clears affected mappings.
findings.proposed_application: Represent relationships with stable references and explicit missing-target diagnostics, not fragile display-name joins.
findings.acceptance: Rename a nested folder shared by options and verify all relations; delete/undo restores mapping without silently selecting a different asset.

findings.documented_observation: Replayable tutorial follows import, downloads, profile organization, deployment and launch.
findings.proposed_application: Use resumable task-specific walkthroughs with owned fixtures and verifiable checkpoints; show real progress rather than scripted success.
findings.acceptance: Cancel tutorial halfway, return later, and resume from actual stored state without modifying a real game.
